# PhpUnitDeprecations

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [PHPUnit](/rules/#phpunit) · PhpStorm name: `PhpUnitDeprecationsInspection`

Flags PHPUnit assertion APIs deprecated in the configured PHPUnit version:
the optional trailing parameters of `assertEquals()` / `assertNotEquals()`
(deprecated in 8.0 in favour of dedicated assertions) and the
`assertFileNotExists()` / `assertDirectoryNotExists()` assertions (deprecated
in 9.1 in favour of their `...DoesNotExist()` counterparts).

## Example

With `PHP_UNIT_VERSION = PHPUNIT80`:

```php{7,10,11,12,13}
<?php

final class InvoiceTest
{
    public function testTotals()
    {
        $this->assertEquals(10.5, $sum, 'sum differs', 0.01);
        self::assertNotEquals(
            [1, 2], $ids, '',
            0,
            $depth,
            true,
            $fold = true
        );
        $this->assertEquals('a', $label, 'label differs');
        $this->assertFileNotExists('/tmp/out.csv');
    }
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 7: PHPUnit 8.0 deprecated the delta argument; call assertEqualsWithDelta() instead.</li>
<li>line 10: PHPUnit 8.0 deprecated the delta argument; call assertNotEqualsWithDelta() instead.</li>
<li>line 11: PHPUnit 8.0 deprecated the maxDepth argument; drop it.</li>
<li>line 12: PHPUnit 8.0 deprecated the canonicalize argument; call assertNotEqualsCanonicalizing() instead.</li>
<li>line 13: PHPUnit 8.0 deprecated the ignoreCase argument; call assertNotEqualsIgnoringCase() instead.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PHP_UNIT_VERSION` | enum (`PHPUNIT70` … `PHPUNIT95`, see ordering above) | `PHPUNIT80` | PHPUnit version targeted by the project. D1/D2 need ≥ `PHPUNIT80`; D3 needs ≥ `PHPUNIT91`. Unset → inferred from the indexed PHPUnit (see Divergences). |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "PhpUnitDeprecations": {
      "enabled": false,
      "options": {
        "PHP_UNIT_VERSION": "PHPUNIT80"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore PhpUnitDeprecations

/**
 * @noinspection PhpUnitDeprecationsInspection
 */
```
